name: Alice & Bob
description: Alice & Bob develops cat qubit quantum computers designed for fault-tolerant quantum computing. Their technology uses superconducting circuits with reduced error rates, aiming to build practical quantum computers that require fewer physical qubits for error correction.

products.name: Cat Qubit Processor
products.description: Superconducting quantum processor using cat qubits for inherent bit-flip error suppression

products.name: Felis Cloud Platform
products.description: Cloud-based access to cat qubit quantum computing for algorithm development and testing

highlights: Pioneered cat qubit technology that exponentially suppresses bit-flip errors
Raised over EUR 30M to build fault-tolerant quantum computers with fewer physical qubits
Spun out of ENS Paris and INRIA quantum research groups

news.title: Alice & Bob develops 'Elevator Codes' to slash error rates on cat-qubit systems
news.excerpt: New code family projects up to 10,000x lower logical error rates while requiring only roughly 3x more physical qubits.

news.title: Alice & Bob showcases cat-qubit fault-tolerance advances at APS Global Physics Summit
news.excerpt: More than a dozen talks covered cat-qubit stabilisation, intrinsic error protection and magic-state preparation.

news.title: Alice & Bob awarded $3.9M ARPA-E grant for rare-earth-free magnet design using quantum computing
news.excerpt: U.S. DOE ARPA-E QC³ programme awarded Alice & Bob and partners from Los Alamos National Laboratory and GE Vernova $3.9M to develop fault-tolerant quantum algorithms for discovering rare-earth-free permanent magnets.

news.title: Alice & Bob reaches 251 employees, completing hiring plan 30% ahead of schedule
news.excerpt: The company hired more than 100 employees in seven months, bringing headcount to 251 and completing its hiring plan well ahead of schedule.

news.title: EU SUPREME €50M superconducting quantum manufacturing project kicks off in Helsinki with Alice & Bob as consortium partner
news.excerpt: The 23-partner SUPREME consortium held its official kick-off at VTT Helsinki (11–13 May), targeting TRL 6 industrialization of superconducting quantum chip manufacturing over 3.5 years. Alice & Bob will use the shared foundry to design and test cat-qubit chips.

news.title: Alice & Bob expands €100M Series B with investment from NVIDIA's NVentures
news.excerpt: NVIDIA's venture arm NVentures joined Alice & Bob's Series B in an undisclosed extension, deepening collaboration on CUDA-Q, cuQuantum, and NVQLink for hybrid quantum-classical workloads on GPU supercomputers.

news.title: Alice & Bob secures NVIDIA NVentures investment as Series B extension
news.excerpt: NVentures, NVIDIA's strategic investment arm, backed Alice & Bob in an extension of its Series B round, deepening the two companies' technical collaboration on integrating cat-qubit processors with NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure and software stack.

news.title: Alice & Bob releases five-criteria framework for evaluating logical qubits across hardware modalities
news.excerpt: Alice & Bob published a framework defining logical qubit performance using five measurable criteria, aiming to establish a standardised benchmark for fair comparison across different quantum hardware approaches.

news.title: Alice & Bob unveils Helium — first on-premise cat-qubit quantum system for research partners
news.excerpt: Alice & Bob launches the Helium Quantum System, a complete on-premise cat-qubit system encoding one logical qubit from 18 cat qubits with ~40 kW power draw, including the Starboard monitoring interface and Slurm-compatible scheduler integration via the open-source QRMI library.

news.title: Alice & Bob unveils Helium Quantum System, its first complete on-premise quantum computer for research partners
news.excerpt: The Helium Quantum System encodes Alice & Bob's first logical qubit with as few as 18 cat-qubits and includes Starboard control software with Slurm scheduler compatibility. An upgradeable platform, it will also support the forthcoming 48-cat-qubit chip.

news.title: France's GENCI acquires Alice & Bob cat-qubit quantum computer in world's first state procurement of cat-qubit system
news.excerpt: GENCI and Alice & Bob signed an agreement at VivaTech for an 18-cat-qubit quantum computer to be hosted at CEA's TGCC and integrated with the Joliot-Curie supercomputer. The system — the first early fault-tolerant quantum computer in a European computing centre — is expected to be accessible to researchers in 2027.

news.title: Alice & Bob expands €100M Series B with investment from NVIDIA's NVentures venture arm
news.excerpt: NVIDIA's NVentures invested in an extension of Alice & Bob's Series B round. Alice & Bob and NVIDIA collaborate on CUDA-Q, cuQuantum, and NVQLink (NVIDIA's open hybrid quantum-classical architecture). Financial terms were not disclosed.

news.title: Alice & Bob expands €100M Series B with strategic investment from NVIDIA's NVentures arm
news.excerpt: Alice & Bob extended its Series B with an undisclosed investment from NVentures, NVIDIA's venture arm, deepening technical collaboration that spans CUDA-Q, cuQuantum, and Dynamiqs — Alice & Bob's open-source quantum simulation library.

news.title: Alice & Bob unveils Helium, its first complete on-premise cat-qubit quantum system
news.excerpt: Alice & Bob unveiled the Helium Quantum System on June 10, 2026, marking the company's first move beyond developing chips to delivering a full quantum computing system for on-premise deployment. Helium encodes Alice & Bob's first logical qubit with as few as 18 cat qubits.

news.title: France acquires Alice & Bob Helium cat-qubit system for national HPC research infrastructure
news.excerpt: GENCI and Alice & Bob signed an agreement for France to acquire an 18-cat-qubit Helium quantum computer — the world's first deployment of a cat-qubit system. The machine will be installed at the TGCC and integrated with the Joliot-Curie supercomputer, with user access expected in 2027.

news.title: Alice & Bob joins QuBriC, Europe's first MSCA Doctoral Network dedicated to quantum error correction
news.excerpt: Alice & Bob joined QuBriC, a €4.6 million Horizon Europe MSCA Doctoral Network bringing together 16 universities and 7 quantum companies to train 15 PhD researchers in quantum error correction. Alice & Bob contributes cat-qubit expertise to help co-design physical QPUs with logical QEC layers.

news.title: Alice & Bob Joins Europe's First Quantum Error Correction Doctoral Network QuBriC
news.excerpt: Alice & Bob joined QuBriC, a EUR 4.6 million MSCA Doctoral Network uniting 16 academic institutions and seven quantum enterprises to train 15 PhD candidates in quantum error correction. Alice & Bob will contribute its cat-qubit architecture to train researchers in co-designing physical QPUs with logical QEC layers.
